tables.name: documents
tables.comment: Resident and agency documents. Bytes live in the private ghh-documents bucket; this table is the index and the access boundary.

tables.name: invitations
tables.comment: Join codes for an existing agency. Redeemed server-side with service_role, since the redeemer has no profile yet.

tables.name: note_outcomes
tables.comment: Per-note documentation against one ISP outcome. Locked when the note is signed.

tables.name: resident_outcomes
tables.comment: Per-resident ISP outcomes. Drives what the daily note form asks about, which is why every resident sees a different page.

policies.name: documents_read
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND ((resident_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.residents r
  WHERE ((r.id = documents.resident_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(r.home_id))))))

policies.name: note_activities_read
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_activities.note_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id)))))

policies.name: note_activities_write
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_activities.note_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id) AND (NOT n.locked)))))
policies.with_check:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_activities.note_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id) AND (NOT n.locked)))))

policies.name: note_addenda_insert
policies.with_check:
((author_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_addenda.note_id) AND (n.org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id) AND (n.status = 'signed'::ghh.note_status)))))

policies.name: note_addenda_read
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_addenda.note_id) AND (n.org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id))))

policies.name: note_outcomes_read
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_outcomes.note_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id)))))

policies.name: note_outcomes_write
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_outcomes.note_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id) AND (NOT n.locked)))))
policies.with_check:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.notes n
  WHERE ((n.id = note_outcomes.note_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(n.home_id) AND (NOT n.locked)))))

policies.name: notes_delete_draft
policies.qual: ((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (author_id = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'draft'::ghh.note_status) AND (NOT locked))

policies.name: notes_insert
policies.with_check: ((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND ghh.can_access_home(home_id) AND (author_id = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'draft'::ghh.note_status) AND (NOT locked))

policies.name: notes_update
policies.qual: ((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND ghh.can_access_home(home_id) AND (author_id = auth.uid()) AND (NOT locked))

policies.name: outcome_activities_read
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (ghh.resident_outcomes o
     JOIN ghh.residents r ON ((r.id = o.resident_id)))
  WHERE ((o.id = outcome_activities.outcome_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(r.home_id)))))

policies.name: profiles_self_update
policies.with_check: ((id = auth.uid()) AND (org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (role = ghh.auth_role()) AND active)

policies.name: resident_outcomes_read
policies.qual:
((org_id = ghh.auth_org()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.residents r
  WHERE ((r.id = resident_outcomes.resident_id) AND ghh.can_access_home(r.home_id)))))

policies.name: staff_homes_write
policies.qual:
(ghh.is_supervisor() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.homes h
  WHERE ((h.id = staff_homes.home_id) AND (h.org_id = ghh.auth_org())))))
policies.with_check:
(ghh.is_supervisor() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ghh.homes h
  WHERE ((h.id = staff_homes.home_id) AND (h.org_id = ghh.auth_org())))))
